api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Sales Orders: List Sales Orders

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports OrderNumber, Status, CustomerId, OrderedDate, SourceOrderSystem. Example: q=Status='BOOKED' and CustomerId=300000001234567
api_arguments.fields: string: Comma-separated list of fields to return.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, charges, paymentTerms, addresses
api_arguments.offset: integer: Starting position in the result set. Default is 0.
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum number of records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count in the response.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves a list of sales orders. Supports filtering by status, customer, and order date.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Sales Orders: Get a Sales Order

api_arguments.HeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the sales order header.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, charges, paymentTerms, addresses, attachments
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific sales order including lines, pricing, and fulfillment status.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Sales Orders: Create a Sales Order

api_arguments.SourceTransactionNumber: [REQUIRED] string: Unique order number from the source system.
api_arguments.SourceTransactionSystem: [REQUIRED] string: Identifier of the source system submitting the order. Example: 'OPS', 'CRM'.
api_arguments.SourceTransactionId: [REQUIRED] string: Unique identifier for the transaction in the source system.
api_arguments.TransactionTypeCode: [REQUIRED] string: Order type code. Example: 'STD' for standard order.
api_arguments.RequestedShipDate: string: Requested shipment date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.ShippingMethod: string: Shipping carrier and method code.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Array of order line objects. Each line must include SourceTransactionLineId, SourceTransactionLineNumber, ProductNumber, OrderedQuantity, and UOMCode.

functionality: Creates a new sales order with header and line details. Supports import from external source systems.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Sales Orders: Cancel a Sales Order

api_arguments.HeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the sales order to cancel.
api_arguments.Status: [REQUIRED] string: Set to 'CANCELLED' to cancel the order.
api_arguments.CancelReasonCode: string: Reason code for cancellation. Example: 'CUSTOMER_REQUEST'.
api_arguments.CancelledQuantity: number: Quantity to cancel. Omit to cancel the full order.

functionality: Cancels an existing sales order or reduces the ordered quantity on a line.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Inventory Items: List Inventory Items

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ItemNumber, ItemDescription, OrganizationCode, LifecyclePhase, ItemType. Example: q=OrganizationCode='M1' and LifecyclePhase='Active'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: itemCategories, itemRelationships, substitutes, units
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.
api_arguments.orderBy: string: Sort field and direction. Example: orderBy=ItemNumber:asc

functionality: Retrieves inventory items defined across organizations. Supports filtering by item number, organization, and lifecycle status.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Inventory Items: Get an Inventory Item

api_arguments.ItemId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the inventory item.
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: itemCategories, itemRelationships, itemRevisions, units, substitutes
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves full details of a specific inventory item, including unit of measure, category assignments, and stocking attributes.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Inventory Items: Create an Inventory Item

api_arguments.ItemDescription: [REQUIRED] string: Description of the inventory item.
api_arguments.OrganizationCode: [REQUIRED] string: Organization code where the item is defined. Example: 'M1'.
api_arguments.ItemType: string: Item type. Valid values: Standard, Kit, Model, Option Class, Planning.
api_arguments.UOMCode: [REQUIRED] string: Primary unit of measure. Example: 'Ea' for Each.
api_arguments.LifecyclePhase: string: Item lifecycle status. Valid values: Concept, Preproduction, Production, Discontinuation, Obsolete.
api_arguments.TrackingAttribute: string: Inventory tracking method. Valid values: None, Lot, Serial.
api_arguments.StockedItem: boolean: If true, the item is stocked in inventory.
api_arguments.PurchasedItem: boolean: If true, the item can be purchased.
api_arguments.SoldItem: boolean: If true, the item can be sold.

functionality: Creates a new inventory item in the specified organization.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - On-Hand Quantities: Get On-Hand Quantity for an Item

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ItemNumber, OrganizationCode, SubinventoryCode, LotNumber. Example: q=ItemNumber='AS18947' and OrganizationCode='M1'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves current on-hand inventory quantities for items across organizations, subinventories, and locators.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Inventory Transactions: Create a Miscellaneous Transaction

api_arguments.OrganizationCode: [REQUIRED] string: Organization code where the transaction is performed.
api_arguments.ItemNumber: [REQUIRED] string: Item number for the transaction.
api_arguments.TransactionTypeId: [REQUIRED] integer: Identifier of the transaction type (e.g., Miscellaneous Issue, Miscellaneous Receipt).
api_arguments.TransactionQuantity: [REQUIRED] number: Quantity for the transaction. Negative value for an issue.
api_arguments.TransactionUOMCode: [REQUIRED] string: Unit of measure for the transaction quantity.
api_arguments.TransactionDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date of the transaction. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.LotNumber: string: Lot number if the item is lot-controlled.
api_arguments.SerialNumber: string: Serial number if the item is serial-controlled.
api_arguments.AccountNumber: string: General ledger account number to charge.

functionality: Records a miscellaneous inventory transaction such as an inventory issue or receipt not tied to a purchase order or sales order.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Shipments: List Shipments

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ShipmentNumber, Status, ShipFromOrganizationCode, ShipToPartyId, ShipDate. Example: q=Status='OPEN'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, containers, freightCosts, trackingNumbers
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves outbound shipments from Oracle Shipping. Use filters to scope by status, ship date, or customer.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Shipments: Confirm a Shipment

api_arguments.ShipmentHeaderId: [REQUIRED] integer: The unique identifier of the shipment to confirm.
api_arguments.ShipDate: [REQUIRED] string: Actual ship date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.TrackingNumber: string: Carrier tracking number for the shipment.
api_arguments.CarrierCode: string: Carrier code used for shipping.

functionality: Confirms a shipment to record the actual ship date and carrier details, triggering inventory deduction and billing.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Receipts: List Receipts

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ReceiptNumber, VendorId, OrganizationCode, ReceiptDate, PONumber. Example: q=OrganizationCode='M1' and ReceiptDate >= '2024-01-01'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, transactions
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves receiving transactions for purchased goods and services.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Receipts: Create a Receipt

api_arguments.ReceiptSourceCode: [REQUIRED] string: Source of the receipt. Valid values: 'VENDOR' for supplier receipts, 'CUSTOMER' for customer returns.
api_arguments.ReceiptDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date of the receipt. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.VendorId: integer: Supplier identifier. Required when ReceiptSourceCode is 'VENDOR'.
api_arguments.BillOfLading: string: Bill of lading reference number.
api_arguments.WaybillAirbillNumber: string: Waybill or air bill number.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Array of receipt line objects. Each line must include POHeaderId, POLineId, POLineLocationId, QuantityReceived, and UOMCode.

functionality: Creates a receiving transaction against a purchase order, recording quantity received and delivery details.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Work Orders: List Work Orders

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports WorkOrderNumber, Status, OrganizationCode, ItemNumber, ScheduledStartDate. Example: q=Status='Released' and OrganizationCode='M1'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: operations, materials, outputItems
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves manufacturing work orders. Filter by status, organization, or item to scope results.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Work Orders: Create a Work Order

api_arguments.ItemNumber: [REQUIRED] string: Item number of the assembly to produce.
api_arguments.UOMCode: [REQUIRED] string: Unit of measure for the quantity.
api_arguments.WorkOrderType: [REQUIRED] string: Type of work order. Valid values: Standard, Nonstandard, Rework, Transform.
api_arguments.ScheduledStartDate: [REQUIRED] string: Planned start date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.ScheduledCompletionDate: [REQUIRED] string: Planned completion date. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.BOMRevision: string: Bill of materials revision to use. Defaults to current revision.
api_arguments.RoutingRevision: string: Routing revision to use. Defaults to current revision.
api_arguments.DemandSourceHeaderId: integer: Sales order header identifier if this work order is demand-driven.
api_arguments.ProjectId: integer: Project identifier if this work order is project-costed.

functionality: Creates a new manufacturing work order for producing an assembled item.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Item Structures (BOM): Get Bill of Materials

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports ItemNumber, OrganizationCode, StructureName, EffectiveDate. Example: q=ItemNumber='CM77862' and OrganizationCode='M1'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: components, substitutes
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, includes total count.
api_arguments.effectiveDate: string: Date for which the BOM structure is effective. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves bill of materials (BOM) structures for manufacturing items, including component items and quantities.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Transfer Orders: List Transfer Orders

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports TransferOrderNumber, Status, SourceOrganizationCode, DestinationOrganizationCode, RequestedShipDate. Example: q=Status='OPEN'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid values: lines, shipments
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves inter-organization transfer orders used to move inventory between warehouses or plants.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Transfer Orders: Create a Transfer Order

api_arguments.SourceOrganizationCode: [REQUIRED] string: Organization code of the source (shipping) organization.
api_arguments.DestinationOrganizationCode: [REQUIRED] string: Organization code of the destination (receiving) organization.
api_arguments.RequestedShipDate: [REQUIRED] string: Requested date to ship the transfer. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.ShipmentPriority: string: Priority of the shipment. Example: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low'.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Array of transfer order lines. Each line requires ItemNumber, RequestedQuantity, and UOMCode.

functionality: Creates a new inter-organization transfer order to move inventory between two Oracle SCM organizations.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Supply Requests: Create a Supply Request

api_arguments.SourceSystemCode: [REQUIRED] string: Code of the source system submitting the request.
api_arguments.SourceRequestNumber: [REQUIRED] string: Unique request number from the source system.
api_arguments.ItemNumber: [REQUIRED] string: Item number for which supply is requested.
api_arguments.UOMCode: [REQUIRED] string: Unit of measure for the quantity.
api_arguments.RequestedDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date by which supply is needed. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.ProjectId: integer: Project identifier for project-driven supply.
api_arguments.TaskId: integer: Task identifier within the project.
api_arguments.SubinventoryCode: string: Target subinventory for the supply.

functionality: Creates an external supply request that can trigger planning recommendations for purchase orders, work orders, or transfers.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Cycle Counts: List Cycle Count Sequences

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports CycleCountName, OrganizationCode, Status, SubinventoryCode. Example: q=OrganizationCode='M1' and Status='UNCOUNTED'
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves cycle count sequences for physical inventory counting tasks in a warehouse.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Cycle Counts: Submit a Cycle Count

api_arguments.CycleCountSequenceId: [REQUIRED] integer: Unique identifier of the cycle count sequence.
api_arguments.CountUOMCode: [REQUIRED] string: Unit of measure of the counted quantity.
api_arguments.CountDate: [REQUIRED] string: Date and time the count was performed. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.
api_arguments.LotNumber: string: Lot number if the item is lot-controlled.
api_arguments.SerialNumber: string: Serial number if the item is serial-controlled.

functionality: Submits a physical count against an existing cycle count sequence, recording the actual quantity found.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Lot Numbers: List Lot Numbers

api_arguments.q: string: Filter condition. Supports LotNumber, ItemNumber, OrganizationCode, ExpirationDate, Status. Example: q=ItemNumber='AS18947' and OrganizationCode='M1'
api_arguments.expand: string: Child resources to expand. Valid value: serialNumbers
api_arguments.limit: integer: Maximum records to return. Default is 25.
api_arguments.totalResults: boolean: If true, returns total record count.
api_arguments.onlyData: boolean: If true, suppresses HATEOAS links.

functionality: Retrieves lot numbers for lot-controlled inventory items including expiration dates and current status.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Picking Waves: Create a Picking Wave

api_arguments.ShipMethodCode: string: Filter pick release to a specific shipping method.
api_arguments.ShipToPartyId: integer: Filter pick release to a specific customer.
api_arguments.RequestedShipDateFrom: string: Filter orders with requested ship date from. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.RequestedShipDateTo: string: Filter orders with requested ship date to. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
api_arguments.AutoPickConfirm: boolean: If true, automatically confirms picks after allocation. Default is false.
api_arguments.AutoAllocate: boolean: If true, automatically allocates inventory during wave creation. Default is true.
api_arguments.BatchSize: integer: Maximum number of shipment lines per picking batch.

functionality: Creates a wave of pick releases to group and allocate outbound shipment lines for warehouse picking.

api_name: REST API for Oracle SCM Cloud - Customer Returns: Create a Return Material Authorization

api_arguments.SourceTransactionNumber: [REQUIRED] string: Unique RMA number from the source system.
api_arguments.ReturnReasonCode: [REQUIRED] string: Reason code for the return. Example: 'DEFECTIVE', 'WRONG_ITEM', 'DAMAGED'.
api_arguments.OriginalOrderId: integer: Header ID of the original sales order being returned.
api_arguments.lines: [REQUIRED] array: Return lines. Each line requires SourceTransactionLineId, ProductNumber, ReturnQuantity, and UOMCode.

functionality: Creates a Return Material Authorization (RMA) to process a customer's return of goods.
